note: Text output does not render logos, but visual guidance can accompany an Instagram post.
rules: White logo on dark backgrounds; dark logo on light. Never place a logo on a background that hides it.
The purple 'Now' (#C74FFF) is fixed; never recolor it, never rotate it, never separate 'Now' from 'DISRUPTION.'
Clear space of half the DISRUPTION cap-height on all sides; minimum about 220px wide or switch to the square monogram.
No effects (shadows, glows, outlines); no stretching or squeezing.
Co-branding: Disruption Now leads; partner marks stay smaller and subordinate.
Social platform icons keep their own colors; size 48 to 56px.
Prefer real photographs of people building over AI-generated images.
